connection_condition: Question posts are rows of the same posts store as every other content kind, distinguished by the post type code
description: A question post is a specific kind of post. Its value domain is a subset of all posts, and it adds question-only attributes such as title, tags and answer counters.

connection_condition: Answer posts are rows of the same posts store as every other content kind, distinguished by the post type code
description: An answer post is a specific kind of post. It shares the post identity space and adds answer-specific attributes such as its parent question reference.

connection_condition: Tag documentation posts are rows of the same posts store, distinguished by their post type codes
description: A tag wiki post is a specific kind of post whose content documents a tag rather than asking or answering a question.

connection_condition: comments.PostId references posts.Id, and is populated on every comment
description: A post is composed of the comments attached to it. A comment cannot exist without its post.

connection_condition: an answer post carries a reference to the question post it responds to; questions carry no such reference
description: A question is composed of the answers submitted to it. An answer is only meaningful as a response to its question.

connection_condition: votes.PostId references posts.Id, and is populated on every vote
description: A post is composed of the votes cast on it. A vote cannot exist without the post it rates.

connection_condition: postHistory.PostId references posts.Id, and is populated on every revision event
description: A post is composed of its revision events. A revision is only meaningful as a state of its post.

connection_condition: postLinks.PostId references posts.Id, and is populated on every post link
description: A post is composed of the link records that originate from it. A link record cannot exist without its originating post.

connection_condition: badges.UserId references users.Id, and is populated on every badge award
description: A user is composed of the badge awards granted to them. A badge award cannot exist without a user.

connection_condition: tags.ExcerptPostId and tags.WikiPostId reference posts holding the tag's documentation
description: A tag is composed of its documentation content, held as dedicated posts. That documentation cannot exist without the tag it describes.

connection_condition: posts.OwnerUserId carries the same identifier values as users.Id
description: The post owner reference and the canonical user identifier are the same concept expressed in different places; the owner value is a user identifier.

connection_condition: comments.UserId carries the same identifier values as users.Id
description: The comment author reference and the canonical user identifier are the same concept expressed in different places.

connection_condition: votes.UserId carries the same identifier values as users.Id
description: The vote author reference and the canonical user identifier are the same concept expressed in different places.

connection_condition: posts.LastEditorUserId carries the same identifier values as users.Id
description: The last-editor reference and the canonical user identifier are the same concept expressed in different places.

connection_condition: the stored comment counter on a post corresponds to the number of comment records referencing that post
description: A post's comment count is derived by counting the comments attached to it. The stored counter is a materialized copy of that count.

connection_condition: the stored answer counter on a question corresponds to the number of answer posts referencing it
description: A question's answer count is derived by counting its answer posts.

connection_condition: the stored tag usage counter corresponds to the number of question posts whose serialized tag value carries that tag
description: A tag's usage count is derived by counting the questions carrying that tag. The stored counter is a materialized copy.

connection_condition: the stored per-post rating is sustained by the positive and negative vote records the post has received
description: A post score is derived from the net effect of the votes cast on the post. It is stored as a materialized rating rather than recomputed from vote rows.

connection_condition: a post's serialized tag value is formed by concatenating its tag names, each wrapped in bracket characters
description: The tag value stored on a post is derived by concatenating the names of the tags applied to it, so membership tests must account for the bracketed encoding rather than the bare tag name.

connection_condition: a post may reference its authoring user, but the reference is absent for imported or anonymous content
description: Users author posts. The authorship link is optional, so posts are not strictly dependent on a user record.

connection_condition: a comment may reference its authoring user, but the reference is absent for some rows
description: Users write comments. The authorship link is optional and must be handled as missing for part of the rows.

connection_condition: a vote may reference the user who cast it, but the reference is absent for most rows
description: Users cast votes. Because the casting user is recorded only for a minority of rows, the association holds in principle but not reliably at the data level.

connection_condition: the related-post reference on a link record points at another post
description: A post link connects two posts, so a link record is associated with the post on its related side in addition to the post it originates from.

connection_condition: a question carries tag names in its serialized tag value; there is no identifier-based join between the tag and the post
description: Tags classify questions, but the link is carried as serialized text on the post rather than as a structural reference, so it is a semantic association at the concept level.

connection_condition: the excerpt reference on a tag resolves to a post holding tag documentation content
description: A tag's excerpt source resolves to the tag documentation content stored as a post, linking the tag-level concept to the documentation post it points at.

connection_condition: a revision event may reference the user who performed it, but the reference is absent for some events
description: Revision events are performed by users, providing an audit trail of editing activity alongside the post-level last-editor reference.
